Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SPRUE PLUGS FOR USE IN FOUNDRIES 



(Reaffirmed 2000) 



1. Scope — This Indian Standard covers requirements for sprue plugs for use in foundries. 

2. Application — Sprue plugs are used in moulding for making sprues. 

3. Dimensions — Dimensions and weights of sprue plugs are specified in Table 1.

Designation of a sprue plug of height 1 25 mm and large diameter of 40 mm is: 

Sprue Plug 125 IS : 6366 



4. Material — 990 percent pure aluminium casting. 

5- Tolerances — Coarse class IS : 2102-1969 ' Allowable deviations for dimensions without specified 
tolerances '. 

6. General — The surface shall be free from casting defects like blow holes, blisters, etc. 

7- Marking — Sprue plugs shall be marked with the following: 

a) Trade-mark or name of the manufacturer, and 

b) Designation. 



Adopted 20 October 1971 



© July 1972, ISI 






INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION 

MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG 

NEW DELHI 1 



IS: 6366-1971 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available from Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 
8. Packing 

8.1 In cardboard boxes, preferably separated by a perforated corrugated paper, each box containing six 
sprue plugs or as directed by the purchaser. 

8.2 Cardboard boxes glued and reinforced with strips may be placed in wooden boxes weighing not 
more than 50 kg overall. The cardboard and wooden boxes may bear the information given under 7 
and the number of pieces. 

9- Supply — As given in IS : 1 387-1 967 ' General requirements for the supply of metallurgical materials 
( first revision ) \ 



Printed at Delhi Printers, Delhi 6, India
